description: Hot Head Flybridge Clears, design, measure, make and fit. - Please see notes for details.

line_items.description: Hot Head Flybridge Clears, design, measure, make and fit. - Please see notes for details.

notes.job_card_note:
Quote for clears on flybridge, boat name Hot head.

Clears to be fixed with track, no press studs visible on front screen rail. Change from black to white panels/edges done in stamoid. Binding to be done in weatherMAX Binding. Main clears and rail dodgers to be done as one to erase fittings for a cleaner look. White stamoid sewn around where rails are. All exterior tracks will be hidden.clear product as preferred by owner Mark is vybac sheet clear. Comes in keg of 5 sheets. If more than 5 sheets are needed it will be $400. Per sheet. This will be confirmed before any work is started. Also need to make sure tracks on roof are correct colour and in good condition. As discussed will need to meet mark on the boat to discuss exactly how we plan to do the job and get any input / preferences from Mark.

$11,300 + gst
